module_reports_desc: Reports of the launcher's own problems: failures, crashes and what you describe
reports_settings_desc: Reports of launcher problems to the developers: your contact, so they can reach you
reports_alert_gone: This alert's report is no longer available
problem_report_hint: Describe what happened. The launcher adds its own log to the report — no game logs; your home folder's path and sign-in tokens are hidden.
problem_report_message_hint: What you did, what you expected and what happened instead…
support_problem_desc: Describe what went wrong: the launcher adds its own log to the report
crash_prompt_text: Last time the launcher (version {version}) hit an internal error. Send a report so it gets fixed sooner: it carries the launcher's log, no game logs.
crash_prompt_comment_hint: For example: pressed Play on a modded build…
